# Portfonia

> Portfonia provides a read-only personal data API for a user's own AI agent: reports, complete daily holding snapshots and holding-related intelligence. Access uses personal API tokens and subscription entitlements. Portfonia provides information and context, not investment advice.

## Docs

- [API reference](https://portfonia.com/agent.md): Authentication, endpoints, response schemas, limits and data handling.
- [Human guide and token settings](https://portfonia.com/agent): Getting started and personal token management.

## Guides

- [Jade guides index](https://portfonia.com/guides): Public explanations of all five Jade portfolio tools.
- [Historical stress scenarios guide](https://portfonia.com/guides/jade-stress): A historical shock, peak-relative paths and asset-class contributions.
- [Style exposure guide](https://portfonia.com/guides/jade-style): Returns-based style weights, fit and their interpretation.
- [Tracking error guide](https://portfonia.com/guides/jade-tracking): Excess return and variability against daily constant reference weights.

- [Holdings replay guide](https://portfonia.com/guides/jade-replay): Unchanged quantities, total return, metrics, proxies and historical currency conversion through a fixed example.
- [Tail risk (VaR / CVaR) guide](https://portfonia.com/guides/jade-var): Historical loss boundaries, tail averages, overlapping monthly windows and the questionnaire reference through a fixed example.
